blocks.text: Find and Fix Web Application Weaknesses Before They Are Exploited
Cybersentinels Consulting assesses web applications for vulnerabilities that could expose sensitive data
Our web application penetration testing combines structured coverage, manual analysis

sections.heading: Security Testing Built Around Application Behavior

blocks.text: Web applications often contain complex user roles, integrations, workflows and business rules
We assess the application from an attacker’s perspective while considering its intended design, user roles

sections.heading: Web Application Security Areas We Assess

blocks.text: Testing is tailored to the application and may address:
Authentication
Review login, password reset, account recovery, multi-factor authentication
Authorization and Access Control
Test whether users can access functions, records or administrative capabilities beyond their
Session Management
Evaluate session creation, renewal, invalidation, token handling, timeout
Input Handling and Injection
Assess whether untrusted input can alter commands, queries, templates
Business Logic
Examine workflows for abuse cases such as bypassed approvals, manipulated transactions
Data Protection
Review exposure of sensitive data through responses, errors, browser storage, caching, transport
File and Content Handling
Assess uploads, downloads, file processing and content-rendering behavior for security
Security Configuration
Review headers, error handling, exposed components, debug functionality
Client-Side Security
Evaluate browser-executed functionality and trust boundaries
1. Application Scoping
Understand URLs, environments, user roles, workflows, technologies, integrations, exclusions
2. Mapping and Reconnaissance
Map accessible functionality, parameters, roles, endpoints, content and trust boundaries
3. Automated and Manual Testing
Use appropriate tools together with manual techniques to assess the application
4. Business-Logic Analysis
Review workflows and role interactions for abuse cases that require application context
5. Controlled Validation
Safely validate relevant weaknesses and document reproducible evidence within the authorized
6. Reporting and Remediation Guidance
Explain affected functions, impact, evidence, severity and recommended corrective actions
7. Retesting
Verify implemented fixes and identify whether the original weakness remains observable
